/*
Install Fly Genetics
====================
One-file installer for the Drosophila genotype scripts (Genotype, Cross
Genotypes, Cross Mode, Tidy, Tidy Below, Select Lineage, Select Below, Break
Cross, Update Fly Genetics) and the Computer Modern font they draw with.

To install: put this file in your Excalidraw script folder (Settings ->
Excalidraw -> Excalidraw Automate -> Script folder; default
Excalidraw/Scripts), then run "Install Fly Genetics" from the command palette.

What it does:
  1. Writes the scripts into the script folder. Scripts you have not edited are
     updated silently; it asks before replacing ones you have edited.
     "Update Fly Genetics" later pulls newer versions from GitHub.
  2. Writes the Computer Modern Serif font (cmu-serif-500-roman.ttf) and its
     license (SIL Open Font License) to Excalidraw/Fonts/.
  3. Enables Excalidraw's local font and points it at that file. Asks first
     if the local font is already set to a different file.
It does not change hotkeys. Suggested (Settings -> Hotkeys): Genotype,
Cross Genotypes, Cross Mode (Shift+9), Tidy, Tidy Below, Select Below.

Built from https://github.com/half-adder/excalidraw-genetics by
installer/build.py; version and build date are in PAYLOAD below.

Test hook (consumed on read): window._flyGeneticsInstallTarget =
  { scriptFolder, fontFolder, skipSettings, confirm }
redirects the install and answers the prompts, for testing.
*/

a unit with\n// no anchored genotype only counts in a block of such units). `packAll`\n// merges the whole row into one block.\nfunction resolveRow(units, packAll) {\n  units.sort((a, b) => a.key - b.key || a.oxKey - b.oxKey || cmpStr(a.seq[0], b.seq[0]));\n  const pos = c => (c.wA ? c.sA / c.wA : c.sF / c.wF);\n  const blocks = [];\n  for (const u of units) {\n    blocks.push({\n      units: [u], width: u.width,\n      wA: u.anchored ? u.weight : 0, sA: u.anchored ? u.weight * u.left : 0,\n      wF: u.anchored ? 0 : 1, sF: u.anchored ? 0 : u.left,\n    });\n    while (blocks.length > 1) {\n      const b = blocks[blocks.length - 1], a = blocks[blocks.length - 2];\n      if (!packAll && pos(a) + a.width + FRAME_GAP <= pos(b) + 0.01) break;\n      const shift = a.width + FRAME_GAP;\n      a.sA += b.sA - b.wA * shift;\n      a.sF += b.sF - b.wF * shift;\n      a.wA += b.wA;\n      a.wF += b.wF;\n      a.units.push(...b.units);\n      a.width = shift + b.width;\n      blocks.pop();\n    }\n  }\n  for (const blk of blocks) {\n    let x = pos(blk);\n    for (const u of blk.units) { u.left = x; glyphEl.width / 2;\n  glyphEl.y = glyphCenterY - glyphEl.height / 2;\n  return glyphEl;\n}\n\n// Group offspring by parent pair.\nconst pairs = new Map();\nfor (const snap of snapshots) {\n  const key = getParentPairKey(snap);\n  if (!key) continue;\n  if (!pairs.has(key)) {\n    pairs.set(key, { maternalId: snap.parents.maternal, paternalId: snap.parents.paternal, children: [] });\n  }\n  pairs.get(key).children.push(snap);\n}\n\n// Label box (and frame growth to cover it) for one offspring.\nfunction addChildLabel(child) {\n  const frame = ea.getElement(child.frameId);\n  const renderableTop = frame.y + FRAME_PAD;\n\n  // Create label FIRST so we can measure its height and route the lineage\n  // arrow to terminate above the label (otherwise the arrow's endpoint sits\n  // INSIDE the label's vertical band and visually crosses through it).\n  let labelEl = null;\n  let labelParts = [];\n  if (child.labelText) {\n    const { boxId, textId } = addLabelBox(child.labelText, child.center.x, renderableTop - Infinity, s.center.y - s.height / 2));\n  rowBottom.set(d, Math.max(rowBottom.get(d) ?? -Infinity, s.center.y + s.height / 2));\n}\n\n// Path of a lineage arrow from the x glyph's bottom middle (x1, y1) on row\n// `dFrom` to the child's frame top middle (x2, y2) on row `dTo`. a : b;\n    if (!inBetween.has(depths.get(left.gid) ?? 0)) continue;\n    const gx = glyphPos.get(m + \"|\" + p);\n    spans.push([gx - CROSS_W / 2, gx + CROSS_W / 2]);\n  }\n  const clearOf = FRAME_GAP / 4;\n  const free = x => spans.every(([l, r]) => x <= l - clearOf || x >= r + clearOf);\n  // Candidates: straight down from the x or up to the child, the middle of\n  // each gap between obstacles, and just outside the obstacles.\n  spans.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);\n  const cands = [x1, x2];\n  let reach = -Infinity;\n  for (const [l, r] of spans) {\n    if (reach > -Infinity && l > reach) cands.push((reach + l) / 2);\n    reach = Math.max(reach, r);\n  }\n  cands.push(spans[0][0] - FRAME_GAP / 2, reach + FRAME_GAP / 2);\n  const lane = cands.filter(free)\n    .sort((a, b) => (Math.abs(a - x1) + Math.abs(a - x2)) - (Math.abs(b - x1) + Math.abs(b - x2)) || a - b)[0];\n  const yTop = (rowBottom.get(dFrom) + rowTop.get(between[0])) / 2;\n  const yLow = Math.min((rowBottom.get(between[between.length - 1]) + rowTop.get(dTo)) / 2, y2 - FRAME_PAD);\n  const pts = [[x1, y1], [x1, yTop], [lane, yTop], [lane, yLow], [x2, yLow], [x2, y2]];\n  // Drop zero-length segments and straight-through corners.\n  const out = [];\n  for (const p of pts) {\n    const q = out[out.length - 1];\n    if (q && Math.abs(q[0] - p[0]) < 0.5 && Math.abs(q[1] - p[1]) < 0.5) continue;\n    const o = out[out.length - 2];\n    if (o && ((Math.abs(o[0] - q[0]) < 0.5 && Math.abs(q[0] - p[0]) < 0.5)\n           || (Math.abs(o[1] - q[1]) < 0.5 && Math.abs(q[1] - p[1]) < 0.5))) out.pop();\n    out.push(p);\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n\n// Lineage arrow and criterion for one offspring whose parents' x glyph is\n// `glyphEl` (a workbench element). x1), h: Math.abs(y2 - y1) });\n    }\n  }\n  return boxes;\n}\n\n// Smallest horizontal shift (ties: rightward) that keeps every box in `mine`\n// at least SIBLING_GAP_X - 2 * FRAME_PAD from every vertically overlapping\n// box in `others`.\nfunction clearingShift(mine, others) {\n  const { ok, candidates } = clearance(mine, others);\n  return candidates.find(ok) ?? 0;\n}\n\n// The shifts to consider for `clearingShift`, nearest first (ties:\n// rightward), and a test of whether a shift clears.\nfunction clearance(mine, others) {\n  const gap = SIBLING_GAP_X - 2 * FRAME_PAD, vpad = 2 * FRAME_PAD;\n  const bad = [];\n  for (const a of mine) {\n    for (const b of others) {\n      if (a.y >= b.y + b.h + vpad || a.y + a.h + vpad <= b.y) continue;\n      // A genotype sits beside the x of its own cross by design.\n      if ((a.gid && b.parents?.includes(a.gid)) || (b.gid && a.parents?.includes(b.gid))) continue;\n      bad.push([b.x - (a.x + a.w) - gap, b.x + b.w - a.x + gap]);\n    }\n  }\n  const ok = s => bad.every(([lo, hi]) => s <= lo + 0.5 || s >= hi - 0.5);\n  const candidates = [0, ...bad.flat()].sort((p, q) => Math.abs(p) - Math.abs(q) || q - p);\n  return { ok, candidates };\n}\n\n// Like `lineageBoxes`, but a lineage arrow is its three elbow segments (from\n// the bound ends) rather than their bounding box, so a sibling beside the\n// arrow's corner is not counted as hitting it. Bound ends are looked up in\n// `lookup` (id -> element). Frames carry their `gid` and x glyphs their\n// `parents`, so a genotype is not kept clear of its own cross's x. Used in\n// subset mode, whose obstacles sit right next to the tidied genotypes.\nfunction segmentBoxes(els, lookup) {\n  const boxes = [];\n  for (const e of els) {\n    const kind = e.customData?.kind;\n    if (kind === \"genotype-frame\") {\n      boxes.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, w: e.width, h: e.height, gid: e.customData.genotypeId });\n    } else if (kind === \"cross-glyph\") {\n      const p = e.customData.parents ?? {};\n      boxes.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, w: e.width, h: e.height, parents: [p.maternal, p.paternal] });\n    } else if (kind === \"cross-lineage\" && e.type === \"arrow\") {\n      const pts = boundLineagePoints(e, lookup);\n      if (!pts) continue;\n      // The first segment drops from the x between the parents, like the x.\n      const p = lookup.get(e.startBinding?.elementId)?.customData?.parents ?? {};\n      for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {\n        const [x1, y1] = pts[i - 1], [x2, y2] = pts[i];\n        const box = { x: Math.min(x1, x2), y: Math.min(y1, y2), w: Math.abs(x2 - x1), h: Math.abs(y2 - y1) };\n        if (i === 1) box.parents = [p.maternal, p.paternal];\n        boxes.push(box);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return boxes;\n}\n\n// Elbow path of a lineage arrow from its x glyph's bottom middle to its\n// child frame's top middle, or null if either end is not found.\nfunction boundLineagePoints(arrow, lookup) {\n  const s = lookup.get(arrow.startBinding?.elementId), t = lookup.get(arrow.endBinding?.elementId);\n  if (!s || !t) return null;\n  return lineagePoints(s.x + s.width / 2, s.y + s.height, t.x + t.width / 2, t.y);\n}\n\n// Re-route a workbench lineage arrow along its bound ends and re-center its\n// criterion label, after one end has moved.\nfunction routeLineageArrow(arrow, lookup) {\n  const pts = boundLineagePoints(arrow, lookup);\n  if (!pts) return;\n  const [x0, y0] = pts[0];\n  arrow.x = x0; arrow.y = y0;\n  arrow.points = pts.map(([x, y]) => [x - x0, y - y0]);\n  const xs = arrow.points.map(p => p[0]), ys = arrow.points.map(p => p[1]);\n  arrow.width = Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs);\n  arrow.height = Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys);\n  for (const b of arrow.boundElements ?? []) {\n    const t = b.type === \"text\" ? ea.getElement(b.id) : null;\n    if (!t) continue;\n    const [mx, my] = pathMidpoint(arrow);\n    t.x = mx - t.width / 2;\n    t.y = my - t.height / 2;\n  }\n}\n\n// ---- Dispatch -------------------------------------------------------------\n\nif (selectedGids.size >= 2) {\n  // Exactly the selected genotypes; everything else is an obstacle.\n  await tidyLineage(selectedSeedId, null, selectedGids);\n} else if (selectedSeedId) {\n  // Keep the tidied lineage clear of everything else in the drawing.\n  const others = new Set(ea.getViewElements()\n    .filter(el => !el.isDeleted && el.customData?.genotypeId)\n    .map(el => el.customData.genotypeId));\n  await tidyLineage(selectedSeedId, others);\n} else {\n  const covered = new Set();\n  // Seed each lineage on a founder (no parents) so parents stay put and\n  // offspring are arranged under them; founders are tried first. Each\n  // lineage keeps clear of the lineages tidied before it.\n  const members = ea.getViewElements().filter(el => !el.isDeleted && el.customData?.genotypeId);\n  const hasParents = new Set(members.filter(el => el.customData.parents).map(el => el.customData.genotypeId));\n  const genotypeIds = [...new Set(members.map(el => el.customData.genotypeId))]\n    .sort((a, b) => hasParents.has(a) - hasParents.has(b));\n  let lineages = 0;\n  for (const gid of genotypeIds) {\n    if (covered.has(gid)) continue;\n    const set = await tidyLineage(gid, new Set(covered));\n    covered.add(gid);\n    for (const g of set ?? []) covered.add(g);\n    lineages++;\n  }\n  new Notice(lineages ? `Tidied ${lineages} lineage(s).` : \"No genotypes to tidy.\");\n}\n", "Tidy Below": "/*\nTidy Below\n==========\nTidies only at or below the selected genotype: runs Select Below (the\ngenotype, its descendants and the mates in every cross they parent), then\nTidy, which tidies exactly the selected genotypes. The selected genotype\nstays where it is; its parents, siblings, the x glyph above it and the arrow\ninto it are kept (the arrow is re-bound to it). Everything else in the\ndrawing is an obstacle the tidied part keeps clear of.\n\nUsage:\n  Select any element of a genotype, then run Tidy Below.\n*/\n\nif (!ea.getViewSelectedElements().some(el => el.customData?.genotypeId)) {\n  new Notice(\"Tidy Below: select a genotype first.\");\n  return;\n}\n\nwindow._flySelectResult = undefined;\napp.commands.executeCommandById(\"obsidian-excalidraw-plugin:Select Below\");\nlet result;\nfor (let i = 0; i < 50 && !(result = window._flySelectResult); i++) {\n  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));\n}\nwindow._flySelectResult = undefined;\nif (!result) {\n  new Notice(\"Tidy Below: Select Below did not finish.\");\n  return;\n}\n// Tidy with a single genotype selected would tidy its whole lineage.\nif (result.genotypes < 2) {\n  new Notice(\"Tidy Below: nothing below this genotype to tidy.\");\n  return;\n}\n// Pass the genotypes to Tidy explicitly: the selection Select Below set lands\n// only on Excalidraw's next render.\nwindow._tidySeed = { genotypeIds: result.genotypeIds, at: Date.now() };\napp.commands.executeCommandById(\"obsidian-excalidraw-plugin:Tidy\");\n", "Select Lineage": "/*\nSelect Lineage\n==============\nSelects the whole lineage of the selected genotype: its ancestors,\ndescendants and mates, with every x, arrow, criterion and label between\nthem. Drag the selection to move the lineage together.\n*/\n\nconst MODE = \"lineage\";\n\nif (!ea.verifyMinimumPluginVersion || !ea.verifyMinimumPluginVersion(\"1.9.0\")) {\n  new Notice(\"Requires Excalidraw plugin 1.9.0+.\");\n  return;\n}\n\nconst all = ea.getViewElements().filter(el => !el.isDeleted);\nconst seed = ea.getViewSelectedElements().find(el => el.customData?.genotypeId)?.customData.genotypeId;\nif (!seed) {\n  new Notice(\"Select a genotype first.\");\n  return;\n}\n\n// Crosses as [maternal, paternal, child] from offspring `parents`, plus\n// crosses that have an x but no offspring yet.\nconst parentsOf = new Map();\nfor (const el of all) {\n  const cd = el.customData;\n  if (cd?.genotypeId && cd.parents?.maternal && cd.parents?.paternal) parentsOf.set(cd.genotypeId, cd.parents);\n}\nconst pairs = [...parentsOf.values()];\nfor (const el of all) {\n  const p = el.customData?.kind === \"cross-glyph\" ? el.customData.parents : null;\n  if (p?.maternal && p?.paternal) pairs.push(p);\n}\n\nconst set = new Set([seed]);\nif (MODE === \"lineage\") {\n  // Everything connected through parent/child and mate links.\n  let grew = true;\n  while (grew) {\n    grew = false;\n    const add = g => { if (g && !set.has(g)) { set.add(g); grew = true; } };\n    for (const [child, p] of parentsOf) {\n      if (set.has(child) || set.has(p.maternal) || set.has(p.paternal)) { add(child); add(p.maternal); add(p.paternal); }\n    }\n    for (const p of pairs) if (set.has(p.maternal) || set.has(p.paternal)) { add(p.maternal); add(p.paternal); }\n  }\n} else {\n  // The seed, its descendants, and the mates in every cross they parent.\n  let grew = true;\n  while (grew) {\n    grew = false;\n    for (const p of pairs) {\n      if (!set.has(p.maternal) && !set.has(p.paternal)) continue;\n      for (const g of [p.maternal, p.paternal]) if (!set.has(g)) { set.add(g); grew = true; }\n    }\n    for (const [child, p] of parentsOf) {\n      if (!set.has(child) && (set.has(p.maternal) || set.has(p.paternal))) { set.add(child); grew = true; }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Genotype elements, plus cross furniture whose cross lies inside the set.\n// An arrow is included only if both of its child's parents are in the set, so\n// in \"below\" mode the arrow into the seed stays behind (it is bound and\n// re-routes when the selection is dragged).\nconst crossInside = p => p && set.has(p.maternal) && set.has(p.paternal);\nconst pick = all.filter(el => {\n  const cd = el.customData;\n  if (!cd) return false;\n  if (cd.genotypeId) return set.has(cd.genotypeId);\n  if (cd.kind === \"cross-glyph\") return crossInside(cd.parents);\n  if (cd.kind === \"cross-lineage\" || cd.kind === \"cross-criterion\") return crossInside(parentsOf.get(cd.childGenotypeId));\n  return false;\n});\nea.selectElementsInView(pick);\nwindow._flySelectResult = { mode: MODE, genotypes: set.size, genotypeIds: [...set], elements: pick.length };\n", "Select Below": "/*\nSelect Below\n============\nSelects the selected genotype, its descendants and the mates in every cross\nthey parent, with the x glyphs, arrows, criteria and labels among them. The\narrow into the selected genotype from its own parents is left out; it is\nbound, so it follows when the selection is dragged.\n*/\n\nconst MODE = \"below\";\n\nif (!ea.verifyMinimumPluginVersion || !ea.verifyMinimumPluginVersion(\"1.9.0\")) {\n  new Notice(\"Requires Excalidraw plugin 1.9.0+.\");\n  return;\n}\n\nconst all = ea.getViewElements().filter(el => !el.isDeleted);\nconst seed = ea.getViewSelectedElements().find(el => el.customData?.genotypeId)?.customData.genotypeId;\nif (!seed) {\n  new Notice(\"Select a genotype first.\");\n  return;\n}\n\n// Crosses as [maternal, paternal, child] from offspring `parents`, plus\n// crosses that have an x but no offspring yet.\nconst parentsOf = new Map();\nfor (const el of all) {\n  const cd = el.customData;\n  if (cd?.genotypeId && cd.parents?.maternal && cd.parents?.paternal) parentsOf.set(cd.genotypeId, cd.parents);\n}\nconst pairs = [...parentsOf.values()];\nfor (const el of all) {\n  const p = el.customData?.kind === \"cross-glyph\" ? el.customData.parents : null;\n  if (p?.maternal && p?.paternal) pairs.push(p);\n}\n\nconst set = new Set([seed]);\nif (MODE === \"lineage\") {\n  // Everything connected through parent/child and mate links.\n  let grew = true;\n  while (grew) {\n    grew = false;\n    const add = g => { if (g && !set.has(g)) { set.add(g); grew = true; } };\n    for (const [child, p] of parentsOf) {\n      if (set.has(child) || set.has(p.maternal) || set.has(p.paternal)) { add(child); add(p.maternal); add(p.paternal); }\n    }\n    for (const p of pairs) if (set.has(p.maternal) || set.has(p.paternal)) { add(p.maternal); add(p.paternal); }\n  }\n} else {\n  // The seed, its descendants, and the mates in every cross they parent.\n  let grew = true;\n  while (grew) {\n    grew = false;\n    for (const p of pairs) {\n      if (!set.has(p.maternal) && !set.has(p.paternal)) continue;\n      for (const g of [p.maternal, p.paternal]) if (!set.has(g)) { set.add(g); grew = true; }\n    }\n    for (const [child, p] of parentsOf) {\n      if (!set.has(child) && (set.has(p.maternal) || set.has(p.paternal))) { set.add(child); grew = true; }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Genotype elements, plus cross furniture whose cross lies inside the set.\n// An arrow is included only if both of its child's parents are in the set, so\n// in \"below\" mode the arrow into the seed stays behind (it is bound and\n// re-routes when the selection is dragged).\nconst crossInside = p => p && set.has(p.maternal) && set.has(p.paternal);\nconst pick = all.filter(el => {\n  const cd = el.customData;\n  if (!cd) return false;\n  if (cd.genotypeId) return set.has(cd.genotypeId);\n  if (cd.kind === \"cross-glyph\") return crossInside(cd.parents);\n  if (cd.kind === \"cross-lineage\" || cd.kind === \"cross-criterion\") return crossInside(parentsOf.get(cd.childGenotypeId));\n  return false;\n});\nea.selectElementsInView(pick);\nwindow._flySelectResult = { mode: MODE, genotypes: set.size, genotypeIds: [...set], elements: pick.length };\n", "Break Cross": "/*\nBreak Cross\n===========\nUndo the link between parents and offspring without deleting any genotype.\n\nSelection:\n  - The x between two parents, or elements of BOTH parents of a cross:\n      break that whole cross. The x, all its lineage arrows and selection\n      criteria are removed, and every offspring becomes a standalone genotype.\n  - Elements of an offspring (a genotype with parents):\n      detach just that offspring. Its lineage arrow and criterion are removed;\n      its label stays. If its cross has no offspring left, the x is removed.\nWhole-cross breaks take precedence: selecting a genotype that is both an\noffspring and one of two selected parents breaks the cross it is a parent in.\n\nEverything happens in one scene update, so one undo restores it.\n*/\n\nif (!ea.verifyMinimumPluginVersion || !ea.verifyMinimumPluginVersion(\"1.9.0\")) {\n  new Notice(\"Requires Excalidraw plugin 1.9.0+.\");\n  return;\n}\n\nea.clear();\nconst all = ea.getViewElements().filter(el => !el.isDeleted);\nconst selected = ea.getViewSelectedElements();\nconst kind = el => el.customData?.kind;\nconst pairKey = p => `${p.maternal}|${p.paternal}`;\n\n// ---- What to break -------------------------------------------------------------\n\nconst crosses = new Map(); // pairKey -> { maternal, paternal }\nfor (const el of selected) {\n  if (kind(el) === \"cross-glyph\" && el.customData.parents) {\n    crosses.set(pairKey(el.customData.parents), el.customData.parents);\n  }\n}\nconst selectedGids = new Set(selected.map(el => el.customData?.genotypeId).filter(Boolean));\nfor (const el of all) {\n  const p = el.customData?.parents;\n  if (kind(el) === \"cross-glyph\" && p && selectedGids.has(p.maternal) && selectedGids.has(p.paternal)) {\n    crosses.set(pairKey(p), p);\n  }\n}\n\n// Offspring to detach: every child of a broken cross, plus any selected\n// genotype that has parents and is not itself a parent of a broken cross.\nconst parentsOf = gid => all.find(el => el.customData?.genotypeId === gid && el.customData?.parents)?.customData.parents;\nconst brokenParents = new Set([...crosses.values()].flatMap(p => [p.maternal, p.paternal]));\nconst detach = new Set();\nfor (const gid of new Set(all.map(el => el.customData?.genotypeId).filter(Boolean))) {\n  const p = parentsOf(gid);\n  if (!p) continue;\n  if (crosses.has(pairKey(p))) detach.add(gid);\n  else if (selectedGids.has(gid) && !brokenParents.has(gid)) detach.add(gid);\n}\n\nif (!crosses.size && !detach.size) {\n  new Notice(\"Select the x of a cross, both of its parents, or an offspring to detach.\");\n  return;\n}\n\n// ---- Apply ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nconst toDelete = new Set();\nconst edits = new Map(); // id -> element in the workbench\nconst edit = el => {\n  if (!edits.has(el.id)) {\n    ea.copyViewElementsToEAforEditing([el]);\n    edits.set(el.id, ea.getElement(el.id));\n  }\n  return edits.get(el.id);\n};\n\nfor (const gid of detach) {\n  // Lineage arrows into this offspring, and their bound criterion labels.\n  for (const el of all) {\n    if (el.customData?.childGenotypeId !== gid) continue;\n    if (kind(el) === \"cross-lineage\" || kind(el) === \"cross-criterion\") toDelete.add(el.id);\n  }\n  // Drop `parents` from the offspring's own elements (genotype, frame, label).\n  for (const el of all) {\n    if (el.customData?.genotypeId !== gid || !el.customData.parents) continue;\n    const { parents, ...rest } = el.customData;\n    edit(el).customData = rest;\n  }\n}\n\n// Remove the x of every broken cross, and of any cross that just lost its\n// last offspring.\nconst touchedPairs = new Set([...detach].map(gid => pairKey(parentsOf(gid))));\nconst hasRemainingChild = key => all.some(el =>\n  el.customData?.genotypeId && el.customData.parents &&\n  !detach.has(el.customData.genotypeId) && pairKey(el.customData.parents) === key);\nfor (const el of all) {\n  if (kind(el) !== \"cross-glyph\" || !el.customData.parents) continue;\n  const key = pairKey(el.customData.parents);\n  if (crosses.has(key) || (touchedPairs.has(key) && !hasRemainingChild(key))) toDelete.add(el.id);\n}\n\n// Unhook deleted elements from anything that lists them as bound.\nfor (const el of all) {\n  if (toDelete.has(el.id) || !el.boundElements?.some(b => toDelete.has(b.id))) continue;\n  edit(el).boundElements = el.boundElements.filter(b => !toDelete.has(b.id));\n}\nfor (const el of all.filter(el => toDelete.has(el.id))) edit(el).isDeleted = true;\n\nawait ea.addElementsToView(false, false, true);\n\nconst n = detach.size;\nnew Notice(crosses.size\n  ? `Broke ${crosses.size} cross(es); ${n} offspring now standalone.`\n  : `Detached ${n} offspring from ${n === 1 ? \"its\" : \"their\"} parents.`);\n", "Update Fly Genetics": "/*\nUpdate Fly Genetics\n===================\nChecks GitHub for a newer version of the Fly Genetics scripts and, if there\nis one, downloads the latest installer and runs it. The installer replaces\nscripts you have not edited and asks about any you have.\n\nInstalled by \"Install Fly Genetics\". Source:\nhttps://github.com/half-adder/excalidraw-genetics\n\nTest hooks (consumed on read):\n  window._flyGeneticsUpdateSource = \"<installer text>\"  skip the download\n  window._flyGeneticsUpdateTarget = { scriptFolder, ...installer target }\n*/\n\nconst INSTALLER_URL =\n  \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/half-adder/excalidraw-genetics/main/dist/Install%20Fly%20Genetics.md\";\nconst INSTALLER_NAME = \"Install Fly Genetics\";\n\nconst source = window._flyGeneticsUpdateSource ?? null;\nwindow._flyGeneticsUpdateSource = undefined;\nconst target = window._flyGeneticsUpdateTarget ?? null;\nwindow._flyGeneticsUpdateTarget = undefined;\n\nconst vault = app.vault;\n// The installer must live in the real script folder (the only one Excalidraw\n// registers scripts from); the test target only redirects installed files.\nconst realScriptFolder = (ea.plugin.settings.scriptFolderPath ?? \"Excalidraw/Scripts\").replace(/\\/+$/, \"\");\nconst scriptFolder = (target?.scriptFolder ?? realScriptFolder).replace(/\\/+$/, \"\");\nconst manifestPath = `${scriptFolder}/.fly-genetics.json`;\n\nlet installed = null;\ntry {\n  installed = JSON.parse(await vault.adapter.read(manifestPath)).version;\n} catch (e) { /* no manifest yet: treat as out of date */ }\n\nlet text = source;\nif (text === null) {\n  try {\n    const res = await ea.obsidian.requestUrl({ url: `${INSTALLER_URL}?t=${Date.now()}`, throw: false });\n    if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    text = res.text;\n  } catch (e) {\n    new Notice(`Fly Genetics: could not reach GitHub (${e.message}).`);\n    return;\n  }\n}\n\nconst latest = text.match(/\"version\":\\s*\"([^\"]+)\"/)?.[1];\nif (!latest || !text.includes(\"const PAYLOAD =\")) {\n  new Notice(\"Fly Genetics: the downloaded installer looks wrong; nothing changed.\");\n  return;\n}\nwindow._flyGeneticsUpdateResult = { installed, latest };\nif (installed === latest) {\n  new Notice(`Fly Genetics is up to date (${latest}).`);\n  return;\n}\n\nconst installerPath = `${realScriptFolder}/${INSTALLER_NAME}.md`;\nconst existing = vault.getAbstractFileByPath(installerPath);\nif (existing) await vault.modify(existing, text);\nelse await vault.create(installerPath, text);\n\nnew Notice(`Fly Genetics: updating ${installed ?? \"unknown version\"} -> ${latest}...`);\n// Give the Script Engine a moment to pick up the new installer, then run it.\nawait new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));\nif (target) window._flyGeneticsInstallTarget = target;\napp.commands.executeCommandById(`obsidian-excalidraw-plugin:${INSTALLER_NAME}`);\n"}, "font": {"name": "cmu-serif-500-roman.ttf", "size": 639132, "base64": ""}, "license": {"name": "CMU-OFL.txt", "text": "Copyright (C) Authors of original metafont fonts:\nDonald Ervin Knuth (cm, concrete fonts)\n1995, 1996, 1997 J\"org Knappen, 1990, 1992 Norbert Schwarz (ec fonts)\n1992-2006 A.Khodulev, O.Lapko, A.Berdnikov, V.Volovich (lh fonts)\n1997-2005 Claudio Beccari (cb greek fonts)\n2002 FUKUI Rei (tipa fonts)\n2003-2005 Han The Thanh (Vietnamese fonts)\n1996-2005 Walter Schmidt (cmbright fonts)\n\nCopyright (C) 2003-2009, Andrey V. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE\nCOPYRIGHT HOLDER BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER LIABILITY,\nINCLUDING ANY GENERAL, SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL\nDAMAGES, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING\nFROM, OUT OF THE USE OR INABILITY TO USE THE FONT SOFTWARE OR FROM\nOTHER DEALINGS IN THE FONT SOFTWARE.\n"}};

if (!ea.verifyMinimumPluginVersion || !ea.verifyMinimumPluginVersion("2.19.1")) {
  new Notice("Fly Genetics needs Excalidraw plugin 2.19.1 or newer.");
  return;
}

const target = window._flyGeneticsInstallTarget ?? null;
window._flyGeneticsInstallTarget = undefined;

const vault = app.vault;
const settings = ea.plugin.settings;
const scriptFolder = (target?.scriptFolder ?? settings.scriptFolderPath ?? "Excalidraw/Scripts").replace(/\/+$/, "");
const fontFolder = (target?.fontFolder ?? "Excalidraw/Fonts").replace(/\/+$/, "");
const fontPath = `${fontFolder}/${PAYLOAD.font.name}`;

const confirm = async (question, yes, no) => {
  if (target) return target.confirm ?? true;
  const answer = await utils.suggester([yes, no], [true, false], question);
  return answer === true;
};

async function ensureFolder(path) {
  let cur = "";
  for (const part of path.split("/")) {
    cur = cur ? `${cur}/${part}` : part;
    if (!vault.getAbstractFileByPath(cur)) await vault.createFolder(cur);
  }
}

async function writeText(path, text) {
  const f = vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path);
  if (f) await vault.modify(f, text);
  else await vault.create(path, text);
}

async function writeBinary(path, buffer) {
  const f = vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path);
  if (f) await vault.modifyBinary(f, buffer);
  else await vault.createBinary(path, buffer);
}

const fromBase64 = b64 => Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer;

// ---- 1. Scripts -------------------------------------------------------------
// A manifest (.fly-genetics.json in the script folder) records the version
// and a SHA-256 of each script as installed. A script whose current contents
// still match that hash was not edited by the user and is replaced silently;
// edited scripts are only replaced after asking.

const sha256 = async text => [...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(text)))]
  .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
const manifestPath = `${scriptFolder}/.fly-genetics.json`;
let manifest = { version: null, hashes: {} };
try { manifest = JSON.parse(await vault.adapter.read(manifestPath)); } catch (e) { /* first install */ }

await ensureFolder(scriptFolder);
const plan = [];
for (const [name, text] of Object.entries(PAYLOAD.scripts)) {
  const path = `${scriptFolder}/${name}.md`;
  const f = vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path);
  const current = f ? await vault.read(f) : null;
  let state = current === null ? "new" : current === text ? "same" : "changed";
  if (state === "changed" && manifest.hashes?.[name] === await sha256(current)) state = "update";
  plan.push({ name, path, text, state });
}
const edited = plan.filter(p => p.state === "changed");
if (edited.length && !(await confirm(
  `You have edited ${edited.map(p => p.name).join(", ")}. Replace with version ${PAYLOAD.version}?`,
  "Replace", "Keep my edited copies"
))) {
  for (const p of edited) p.state = "kept";
}
const hashes = { ...(manifest.hashes ?? {}) };
for (const p of plan) {
  if (p.state === "new" || p.state === "changed" || p.state === "update") await writeText(p.path, p.text);
  if (p.state !== "kept") hashes[p.name] = await sha256(p.text);
}
await vault.adapter.write(manifestPath, JSON.stringify({ version: PAYLOAD.version, hashes }, null, 2));

// ---- 2. Font ------------------------------------------------------------------

await ensureFolder(fontFolder);
const fontFile = vault.getAbstractFileByPath(fontPath);
if (!fontFile || fontFile.stat.size !== PAYLOAD.font.size) {
  await writeBinary(fontPath, fromBase64(PAYLOAD.font.base64));
}
await writeText(`${fontFolder}/${PAYLOAD.license.name}`, PAYLOAD.license.text);

// ---- 3. Excalidraw local font setting -----------------------------------------

let fontNote = "";
if (!target?.skipSettings) {
  const alreadyOurs = settings.experimentalEnableFourthFont && settings.experimantalFourthFont === fontPath;
  const otherFont = settings.experimentalEnableFourthFont && !alreadyOurs;
  if (alreadyOurs) {
    fontNote = "Local font was already set to Computer Modern.";
  } else if (!otherFont || await confirm(
    `Excalidraw's local font is set to "${settings.experimantalFourthFont}". Replace it with Computer Modern?`,
    "Use Computer Modern", "Keep my font"
  )) {
    settings.experimentalEnableFourthFont = true;
    settings.experimantalFourthFont = fontPath;
    await ea.plugin.saveSettings();
    if (ea.plugin.initializeFonts) await ea.plugin.initializeFonts();
    fontNote = "Local font set to Computer Modern. Reopen open drawings to see it.";
  } else {
    fontNote = "Kept your local font; genotypes will be drawn in it.";
  }
}

// ---- Report -------------------------------------------------------------------

const summary = plan.map(p => `${p.name}: ${{ new: "installed", changed: "replaced", update: "updated", same: "already current", kept: "kept yours" }[p.state]}`);
window._flyGeneticsInstallResult = { plan: plan.map(({ name, state }) => ({ name, state })), fontPath, fontNote };
new Notice(
  `Fly Genetics ${PAYLOAD.version}\n${summary.join("\n")}\n${fontNote}\n` +
  "Optional: assign hotkeys in Settings -> Hotkeys (search \"Genotype\").",
  15000
);
